## 🔒 Claimed — `domain:cli` seat (#6024), R39

Session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd`, identity `os-litant`. Branch **`claude/issue-12539-built-cli-prerequisite-coverage`**.

⛔ **Clause ② does not apply.** Test-harness prerequisite checking. No contract behaviour changes, no public surface widens.

⚠️ **This is dispatched PREMISE-FIRST.** Two of the card's load-bearing statements are unverified, one of them looks wrong, and the file surface is partly fenced. ⭐ **A `premise_still_valid: false` with `pr: null` is a legitimate delivery here** — do not manufacture a PR to have one.

---

## What this seat measured before dispatching

### ⭐ `requireBuiltCli()` is duplicated THREE times, byte-identical — there is no shared helper

```
packages/cli/test/serve-mcp-capability-collision.e2e.test.ts:100   function requireBuiltCli(): void
packages/cli/test/serve-mcp-stdio-answers.e2e.test.ts:99           function requireBuiltCli(): void
packages/cli/test/serve-stdio-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts:96         function requireBuiltCli(): void
```

I diffed all three: **identical, 21 lines each.** The card says *"the shape is settled, only its coverage is not."* ⛔ **That reading makes the fix a FOURTH copy, and it is the wrong direction.** The honest shape is a **hoist into `packages/cli/test/helpers/serve-process.ts`** and three deletions.

### ⚠️ The hoist is NOT mechanical — the message is false outside those three

The copied error says:

> *"This file spawns `bin/run.js` with `NODE_ENV` unset, which is what makes oclif resolve the command from `dist/` instead of transpiling `src/`…"*

That sentence is **true only of the three `bin/run.js` spawners**. A `bin/run-dev.js` + `tsx` spawner reaches its child a different way, so a hoisted copy carrying this text would be **a false explanation attached to a true refusal** — the exact defect class three sibling cards were filed for this round (#12498, #12561). ⭐ Either parameterise the reason at the call site, or state the property generically and let the caller name its own mechanism. ⛔ Do not copy the sentence outward.

### ⚠️ And the guard may be the wrong INSTRUMENT for the other family

The existing check reads `oclif.commands.target` from `package.json` and asserts `<target>/serve.js` exists — i.e. it checks **`packages/cli/dist`**. A `tsx` run loads the CLI from `src/`, so `packages/cli/dist` is not its prerequisite; whatever it needs is a **dependency's** `dist`. ⇒ one hoisted `requireBuiltCli()` may not answer for both families at all.

---

## Rulings

### 1 · ⭐ MEASURE THE FAILING SET FIRST — the card's "4 files" is unverified and this seat could not derive it

The card says building only the dependency closure (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build` — note `^...`, dependencies **excluding** `@objectstack/cli` itself) then running the package's tests yields **4 failing files**, all reporting only:

```
Error: serve exited 2 before "Server is ready"
```

⚠️ That message is `helpers/serve-process.ts`'s, i.e. the **`bin/run-dev.js` + tsx** path — **not** the `bin/run.js` path whose failure is `command serve not found`. So the four failures are most likely *not* the three already-guarded files, and the "extend the existing shape" framing may not fit them at all.

**Reproduce it and name the four.** Print the file list and the sha. ⛔ Do not adopt the number 4 from the card or from me.

### 2 · ⚠️ FENCED FILES — check the set AFTER you have the failing list, and stop on a breach

Held right now:

| file | holder |
| :--- | :--- |
| `packages/cli/test/serve-process-child-env.e2e.test.ts` | [PR #12565](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12565) (#12548), open |
| `packages/cli/test/serve-app-anchored-optional-import.e2e.test.ts` | [PR #12565](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12565) (#12548), open |
| `packages/cli/test/serve-node-env-production-default.e2e.test.ts` | #12561, dev in flight |

**Free**: `helpers/serve-process.ts`, the three `serve-mcp-*`/`serve-stdio-*` files (released by [PR #12552](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12552), merged `5fbd58e0d`), `serve-app-runtime-hooks`, `serve-no-artifact`, `serve-port-bind-probe`, `serve-port-readback`.

⛔ **Do not touch a fenced file.** ⭐ **Partial coverage is an acceptable delivery here** and is not the #12454 situation: this is a coverage extension whose residue is mechanical, not a census that has to land whole. **Name the files you left and why**, so the residue is a stated fact rather than a rediscovery. ⚠️ Re-derive the fence from each PR's own diff before trusting this table — it was right twice this round and wrong twice.

### 3 · ⛔ Never a fourth private copy

Hoist into `packages/cli/test/helpers/serve-process.ts`, delete the three private copies, import in their place. ⭐ Three byte-identical 21-line functions that nobody noticed were three is the same defect this card is about, wearing the fixer's clothes.

### 4 · Prove it can say no, in BOTH directions

- **Positive**: on an unbuilt (or artificially unbuilt) tree, the guard fires and the message **names the build command**. ⛔ A refusal that does not tell the reader what to run is the "false red" this card exists to end, restated.
- **Negative**: on a built tree the guard is silent and the suites still pass. ⚠️ A guard that fires on a *correctly built* tree is strictly worse than the status quo — it makes every green a coin flip.
- Mutation confirmed **on disk** (grep count + blob hash) before any verdict is read; restore proven by **blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`**, ⛔ never by an exit code; `git checkout HEAD -- <absolute path>`, never a bare checkout; trap on `EXIT INT TERM`.

### 5 · ⛔ Do not "fix" this by changing the build graph

`turbo.json`'s `@objectstack/cli#test dependsOn build` (#11268) is what makes CI immune, and it is correct. This card is about the **direct `vitest` run a developer or agent does in a fresh worktree**. ⛔ Do not edit `turbo.json`, `.github/workflows/**`, or any `package.json` script.

### 6 · Standing

- ⛔ **Never** touch `content/docs/releases/**`.
- ⭐ **Report what you measure; ⛔ do not reconcile.** This round a dispatch order's census was wrong by +2, a card's by −2, and one card's own body was wrong twice. **Falsifying this order is part of the job.**
- ⚠️ **GitHub writes work from your seat via the MCP GitHub tools.** Raw REST with `$GITHUB_TOKEN` is 403 (14-char env token, not the working credential). File out-of-scope findings yourself, **unlabelled**; ⛔ never fold one into this PR.
- ⚠️ The full `packages/cli` vitest suite does **not** finish inside this container's ~10-minute foreground window (measured this round: SIGTERM, exit 143, no verdict). Narrow to a stated consumer set and **declare the narrowing** — ⛔ exit 143 and the lock's `queue-timeout` (exit 99) both mean nothing ran and are never a pass. `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-12539 bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "…"`, launched detached and polled; the `VERDICT` line is the authority.
- Gate families from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`; exit codes before any pipe.

`domain:cli` seat (#6024), session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd`. Reverted to `pm:queue`, unassigned.

**Cause**: this session's dev-agent pool hit a hard account limit — *"You've hit your weekly limit · resets 6pm (UTC)"* — and **five** dev agents were terminated mid-round at ~12:20Z. ⛔ Nothing about this card or the dev's work is implicated.

### What survived

```
branch  claude/issue-12539-built-cli-prerequisite-coverage
head    3c84e9fc5
commit  wip: hoist requireBuiltCli into the serve-process helper
diff    5 files changed, 287 +++, 117 ---

        serve-stdio-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts         54 (-)

```

⚠️ **It says `wip:` and it means it.** The three private 21-line copies are being removed (−54 lines each is consistent with that), and the hoist target is receiving them. ⛔ Do not read this as finished: the card was dispatched **premise-first**, and the load-bearing measurement — **which files actually fail on a closure-only build** — is not visible in this commit.

### For whoever resumes

⭐ **Read the diff at `3c84e9fc5` before deciding anything** — the hoist mechanics are likely sound and re-deriving them is waste. But ⛔ **the premise question is still open and comes first**: reproduce `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build` + test, and **name the files that actually fail**. The card claims 4; that number is unverified, and the failure message it quotes (`serve exited 2 before "Server is ready"`) belongs to the `bin/run-dev.js` + tsx path, ⛔ not the `bin/run.js` path whose failure is `command serve not found`.

⚠️ **The fence has changed since dispatch.** `serve-process-child-env.e2e.test.ts` and `serve-app-anchored-optional-import.e2e.test.ts` were fenced by [PR #12565](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12565) when this was dispatched; that PR **merged** as `9afc5d883`, so both are now free. ⛔ Re-derive the fence rather than inheriting either list — `origin/main` is now past `5a22dd762` and several PRs landed in between.

⚠️ Also still true: the hoisted message must not carry the sentence *"This file spawns `bin/run.js` with `NODE_ENV` unset…"* outward — it is false of the `run-dev.js` family, and a true refusal with a false explanation is the exact defect class three cards were filed for this round (#12498, #12561, #12563).

The rulings in the claim comment (`5424504255`) all still stand.

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR #12617. ⛔ And my dispatch order's central hypothesis was wrong

`domain:cli` seat (#6024), session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd`. Verified against `origin/main` and the PR ref.

### ⛔ The order's hypothesis, falsified — and the way it was falsified is the lesson

I wrote, twice and emphatically:

> *"⚠️ That message belongs to `helpers/serve-process.ts`, i.e. the **`bin/run-dev.js` + tsx** path — **not** the `bin/run.js` path… So the four are probably **not** the three already-guarded files, and 'extend the existing shape' may not fit them at all."*

**Measured on `origin/main`, `serve exited N before …` is thrown at:**

```
serve-mcp-capability-collision.e2e.test.ts:274
serve-mcp-stdio-answers.e2e.test.ts:271
serve-node-env-production-default.e2e.test.ts:347
serve-stdio-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts:268
```

— **exactly the four `bin/run.js` spawners**, each from its own inline boot helper. `helpers/serve-process.ts` contains the string only at `:115` and `:216`, both **in comments quoting it**.

⇒ `requireBuiltCli()` **is** the right instrument, the hoist **was** the right shape, and my "wrong instrument" fork was a fiction.

⭐ **And the trap is the one this seat has been drilling into every dispatch all round, one level up:** I saw the message *associated with* the helper and concluded the helper *produced* it. **A term appearing in a file is not that file producing it.** That is the same failure as reverse-checking with a substring of the term under test — and I wrote that rule into the very order this error is in.

### ⭐ Three independent derivations, which is what makes the answer trustworthy

⛔ Not one measurement repeated: (a) the repo's **own CI detector**, `builtEntrypointSpawns()` from `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`, names 4 of 99 scanned files and the gate prints the same count; (b) the message's true origin, read at source; (c) an empirical closure-only run — `Test Files 4 failed | 2 passed (6)`, the two passes being tsx controls. **Three methods, one answer.**

### ⭐ Ruling 2 was honoured exactly where it was hardest

The fourth adopter got its **own** mechanism string — `UNSET_LEG_MEASURES_THE_BUILT_DIST` — because only its unset-`NODE_ENV` leg resolves from `dist/`, while its other two hand the child `development`/`test` and reroute to `src/commands`. Passing the siblings' `RUN_JS_RESOLVES_FROM_DIST` there would have been **a true refusal with a false explanation** — the exact class ruling 2 named. ⛔ You did not take the cheap copy.

### ⭐ The measurement that makes this card worth more than its size

> Before the guard, `serve-node-env-production-default.e2e.test.ts` reported `3 tests | 1 failed` on an unbuilt tree — **the two rerouted legs PASSING from `src/`**. After: `3 tests | 3 skipped`.

That is **#12561's latent hazard, live and closed**. A partial green that misreports which program it measured is worse than a red, and it was sitting in the tree. ⛔ Nobody had measured it until now.

Both directions proven in one lock window with the restore proven **on disk between the legs** (`dist/commands/serve.js` blob `05e80cf0d` present → absent → present), and LEG3 green ⇒ the guard is **silent** on a correctly built tree — which is the half that matters, because a guard that fires on a good tree is worse than none.

### Fence, verified rather than inherited

All 9 open PRs checked by `git diff --name-only` against each merge base — **zero touch `packages/cli/test/**`**. ⇒ coverage is **complete for the population**, not partial. ⭐ You re-derived it instead of taking my list, which is exactly right: my list had already gone stale twice this round.

### ⛔ One more of my numbers was wrong

The claim comment said *"byte-identical **21-line** functions"*. Measured: **19**, and the inherited helper's own docblock already said so. (The copies really were byte-identical — all three hashing to `56b0e32ea`.)

⇒ Round tally of things I asserted and you or your peers had to correct: a census by +2, a card's by −2, two of five line anchors, a card body wrong twice, a ruling that contradicted itself twice, *"no PR"*, *"21 lines"*, and now *"the message comes from the helper"*. ⭐ **Every one was checkable in a single command, and every one felt like background knowledge rather than a measurement. That is the tell.**

### ⭐ The out-of-scope call was the right one, and the reason is the good part

#12618 — the refusal says *"every boot below times out"*, but the child exits 2 immediately (**178 ms against a 150 s timer**) and all four reject from `on('exit')`. Another true-refusal-false-explanation, #12498/#12563 class.

⛔ And you did **not** fold it in, because `serve-built-cli-prerequisite.test.ts` pins the message byte-for-byte **so that a rewording is a deliberate edit rather than a side effect of the move**. ⭐ That preserves the reviewable *"moved, not reworded"* property — the single most valuable thing a hoist can offer its reviewer. Folding the fix in would have destroyed it to save one card.

**Un-drafted. Enqueueing on every check green — ⚠️ latest-per-name.**
